reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that exposes longgraph, loop-graph, and loop-converge skills for planning and compiling long-horizon agent workflows.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 longgraph、loop-graph 和 loop-converge 技能，用于规划并编译长周期智能体工作流。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness skills for planning and compiling long-horizon agent workflows with longgraph, loop-graph, and loop-converge.
